doc.night_duty.title: St. Agnes Home for Children
doc.night_duty.body: Lights out at nine. Any child found out of bed is to stand in the corridor until I say otherwise. The Hale boy again. He says the little girl in white told him to come down. There is no little girl in white.
clue.locked_linen: The linen cupboard is locked. Sister would keep that key close.
clue.locked_west_dorm: The west dorm won’t open. There’s no keyhole. It’s bolted from the inside.
clue.took_office_key: A key in the washroom drain, tagged “Office”. Someone dropped it in a hurry.
clue.took_linen_key: Sister's desk held a key tagged “Linen”.
clue.read_night_duty: Sister M. punished children found out of bed. The Hale boy talked about a little girl in white.
tapes.warning: Recording over a tape erases it.
tapes.confirm: Record over {tape}?  ENTER yes   ESC no
whisper.rewind.dark: Don't stay in the dark so long. They get in.
whisper.tommy.follow: Come on. Before she checks the beds.
whisper.tommy.washroom: She scrubbed her hands every night. Every single night.
whisper.tommy.names: Follow me. They put the names wrong.
whisper.tommy.cubbies: Everyone had their own shelf. Everyone.
msg.platesSolved: Every name is where it belongs. Something small rolls out from under bed 2.
item.plate.name: Name plate: {name}
item.plate.desc: Tin plate from a bed. Someone scratched at the screws.
item.toy_ball.name: Rubber ball
item.toy_doll.name: Rag doll
item.toy_doll.desc: One button eye. The other is sewn shut.
item.toy_top.name: Spinning top
item.toy_top.desc: Blue and yellow. Still spins true.
item.statue_piece.name: Statue piece
item.statue_piece.desc: A stone hand, broken off a statue at the wrist. The rest of her must be somewhere in this building.
doc.dorm_register.title: Dormitory register
doc.dorm_register.body:
Boys' dormitory, east. Beds as allotted.
1. Walter Price
2. Thomas Hale (“Tommy”)
3. Peter Doyle
4. Sam Pike
5. Alfred Burns (“Alfie”)
6. Arthur Lowe
7. George Finch
8. Frank Ellery
9. Harry Moss
10. Ernest Dunn
No child to change beds without leave.
clue.read_dorm_register: The dorm register lists who slept in each numbered bed. Bed 2 was Thomas Hale. Tommy. Hale, the same name as on my file.
msg.toysSolved: Every toy is home. Down the corridor, a bolt slides back on its own.
clue.took_toy_ball: A red ball in the linen cupboard. Somebody hid it there.
clue.took_toy_doll: A rag doll by the washroom drain. One eye sewn shut.
clue.took_toy_top: A spinning top on the dining hall floor, by the wall.
clue.solved_toys: I put the toys back in their cubbies. The west dorm is open now.
clue.solved_plates: The name plates are back on the right beds. Tommy’s bed gave up a little brass crank.
msg.cubbyEmpty: Empty. Something of theirs should be here.
msg.platesNeedClue: I don’t know whose beds these were. There must be a record somewhere.
msg.toyNeedsClue: Whose was this ({item})? One of the children must have drawn it.
msg.musicBoxNoCrank: The winding key is missing. It won’t play without it.
msg.musicBoxWound: The crank fits. The box ticks, waiting.
msg.lullabySolved: The tune carries on by itself. Behind the east wall, something gives.
clue.saw_drawing_ivy: Ivy drew herself holding a red ball.
clue.saw_drawing_rose: Rose drew herself with her rag doll.
clue.saw_drawing_peter: Peter drew himself with a spinning top.
doc.lullaby_chalk.title: A slate on the playroom wall
doc.lullaby_chalk.body:
A row of little pictures over a wavy line, with a crooked music note at the end:
star, star, moon, bird, moon, heart.
The chalk is fresh.
clue.read_lullaby_chalk: Someone chalked a tune as pictures: star, star, moon, bird, moon, heart.
doc.hale_file_1.title: St. Agnes Home for Children
doc.hale_file_1.body:
Name: T. Hale. Age: [[blot]]
Brought by: the parish. Parents: none living.
Notes: Quiet. Talks to children who are not there. Sister M. recommends the quiet room until he stops.
clue.read_hale_file_1: Page one of a file on T. Hale. The same name as on my file. They kept him in the quiet room.
clue.took_toy_horse: Tommy’s wooden horse. It was in the quiet room, where they kept him.
clue.took_statue_piece: A stone hand from a statue of a saint. The rest of her must be somewhere in St. Agnes. I should keep it.
clue.solved_lullaby: I played the chalked tune on the music box. A hidden door opened in the west dorm.
msg.mapTaken: A plan of the wing. Added to the journal (J, MAPS).
msg.mapPencilled: I pencil the room onto the map.
clue.visited_quiet_room: The quiet room. Small, bare, a drawing of a horse on the wall. It’s on my map now.
intro.whisper2: Find our things. Then we can all go to sleep.
item.flashlight.name: Flashlight
look.drawing.house: A house with a red roof and one door. Someone drew it over and over.
look.drawing.horse: A wooden horse, drawn very carefully. A name underneath has been rubbed out.
look.drawing.children: Children holding hands in a row. One at the end is only an outline.
look.drawing.sun: A yellow sun over green grass. Outside.
msg.lockedAway: The cabinet is locked. There’s a little bulb in the lock, dark.
msg.fusesPowerOn: The lights are on. Better not touch it.
msg.fusesNeedClue: Four levers, numbered. Someone must have written down which order.
msg.fusesWrong: The levers snap back up with a crack.
msg.fusesSolved: Light floods back down the corridor. Across the room, the cabinet lock clicks open.
msg.lightsOut: Every light in the wing dies at once.
doc.night_rota.title: Night duty rota
doc.night_rota.body: If the lights fail, do not wake the children. Go to the fuse box in the sick bay and pull the levers in the order of tonight’s hymns (see the board in the dining hall). Any other order and the box trips again.
clue.read_night_rota: If the lights fail: the fuse box in the sick bay, levers in the order of tonight’s hymns, on the board in the dining hall.
clue.saw_hymn_board: Tonight’s hymns, on the dining hall board: 3, 1, 4, 2.
clue.solved_fuses: I got the lights back on. The medicine cabinet in the sick bay opened by itself.
doc.punishment_book.title: Punishment book
doc.punishment_book.body:
Monday. Two out of bed after lights out. Corridor until midnight.
Tuesday. The Hale boy, talking in the dark again. The quiet room.
Wednesday. The Hale boy.
Thursday. The Hale boy. He says he is not afraid of the quiet room. He will be.
clue.read_punishment_book: Sister M.’s punishment book. Tommy is in it almost every night. Always the quiet room.
doc.letter_peter.title: A page from a diary
doc.letter_peter.body:
Tuesday.
I lent Tommy my spinning top and he gave it back the very next day, like he promised.
Then Sister took it and hid it in the dining hall, so I would cry at supper.
I did not cry. I will not cry tomorrow either.
clue.read_letter_peter: Peter’s diary: Sister hid his spinning top in the dining hall to make him cry.
doc.letter_rose.title: A note under a pillow
doc.letter_rose.body: The music box only plays for Tommy. He says the lady in the walls likes it. I don’t like the lady in the walls.
clue.read_letter_rose: Rose wrote that the music box only plays for Tommy, and that a “lady in the walls” likes it.
doc.nurse_log.title: Sick bay log
doc.nurse_log.body:
Three in with the cough. Gave linctus.
T. Hale brought in again from the quiet room, cold to the touch, no fever. Would not say who he had been talking to.
The cabinet lock is on the lighting circuit. When the fuses go, so does the key.
clue.read_nurse_log: The nurse’s log: the medicine cabinet’s lock runs on the lights. When the fuses go, it stays shut.
doc.menu_card.title: This week’s menu
doc.menu_card.body:
Monday: porridge, bread and dripping.
Tuesday: porridge, boiled potatoes.
Wednesday: porridge.
Thursday: porridge.
Children who leave food will have it again at breakfast.
clue.took_battery: A spare battery for the flashlight, for when the light runs low.
msg.batteryIn: Fresh battery in. The beam steadies.
tutorial.inventory: {open} shows what you carry. Pick an item, then {use} to use it.
whisper.tommy.wall: She puts him behind the wall when he cries. Rose knows.
tutorial.move: {keys} to walk, the mouse to look around.
tutorial.pause: ESC pauses the tape. Controls and settings are under SETUP.
tutorial.run: Hold {key} to run. It is loud, and it tires you.
tutorial.crouch: {key} to crouch: slow and quiet. In SETUP it can be a toggle instead of a hold.
tutorial.lean: {left} and {right} lean to peek round corners.
tutorial.use: {key} uses what is in front of you: doors, notes, things to take.
tutorial.save: Recording on a tape recorder saves your game. REWIND on the main menu plays it back.
tutorial.journal: {journal} opens your journal: clues, documents, maps. In DOCUMENTS, {hold} keeps one at your side.

doc.rose_bed_note.title: A note on Rose’s bed
doc.rose_bed_note.body: Tommy only plays the music box with the song from the playroom slate. Then the wall lets him in. I watched.
clue.read_rose_bed_note: Rose wrote that Tommy plays the music box with the song from the playroom slate, and then the wall lets him in.
card.title: NEW ITEM
card.flashlight.body: The dark wears on your mind; light keeps it steady. It runs on batteries.
card.battery.body: For the flashlight. Each one lasts about eight minutes of light.
card.battery.use: {battery}  swap it in when the light runs low
card.pills.body: No label. They steady the hands and the mind when everything starts to slip.
